turns.user: Can I return an unused backpack delivered 18 days ago?
turns.assistant: Yes. Unused merchandise can be returned within 30 calendar days after delivery. Start the return with the order number and either the purchasing email or delivery postal code.

turns.user: When should I expect the card credit?
turns.assistant: The warehouse normally inspects the return within three business days, and the bank may need another three to seven business days to post the credit.

turns.user: My express order is past the checkout estimate. What can support do?
turns.assistant: Support can compare the carrier history with the dated checkout estimate. Express shipping can be refunded when the carrier missed that window and the delay was not caused by an address issue, hold, severe weather, or failed delivery attempt.

turns.user: The order is marked delivered, but I cannot find it.
turns.assistant: Check household members, building staff, safe-drop locations, and the delivery photo. A scan can precede delivery by up to 24 hours; if it is still missing after that, support can open a claim.

questions: How many battery-electric buses are active, and what is the current target?

documents.text: As of June 30, 2025, 118 of 250 active buses were battery-electric. Resolution 2025-41 set a target of 152 battery-electric buses in active service by December 31, 2026. Four buses were commissioning, 22 were contracted but not delivered, and eight were authorized but not contracted.

questions: Why do the annual electric-fleet savings estimates disagree?

documents.text: The auditor estimated $6.8 million in annualized fuel and scheduled-maintenance savings for 118 active battery-electric buses using invoices and work orders.
The Budget Office published an $8.6 million estimate but supplied no workbook or reconciliation to the auditor's $6.8 million estimate.

questions: Does the procurement evidence independently confirm the delivery schedule?

documents.text: The budget brief relies on a procurement note that in turn follows the committee briefing materials, including the same brief. Neither source includes the manufacturer's production schedule.
